title: ProductRequestLineItem - Data API
description: Represents a request for a part in field service. Product request line items are components of product requests.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: The account associated with the product request line item. This is a relationship field.

CareProgramEnrolleeId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CareProgramEnrolleeId.description: The ID of the care program enrollee associated with the product request line item. This field is available from API version 49.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

CaseId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CaseId.description: The case associated with the product request line item. This is a relationship field.

Description.description: Details not recorded in the provided fields.

DestinationLocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DestinationLocationId.description: Where the product is delivered. This is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last interacted with this record, directly or indirectly.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, it’s possible that the user only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

NeedByDate.description: Date the product must be delivered by.

ParentId.description: The product request that the line item belongs to. This is a relationship field.

Product2Id.description: The product associated with the product request line item. This is a relationship field.

ProductRequestLineItemNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
ProductRequestLineItemNumber.description: (Read Only) An auto-assigned number that identifies the product request line item.

QuantityUnitOfMeasure.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
QuantityUnitOfMeasure.description: Units of the requested product; for example, grams, liters, or units. The picklist values can be customized.

ShipToAddress.description: The physical address where the product is needed.

ShipToCity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToCity.description: The city of the address where the product is needed.

ShipToCountry.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToCountry.description: The country of the address where the product is needed.

ShipToGeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ShipToGeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of the geocode for the address where the product is needed. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields. This field is available in the API only.

ShipToLatitude.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address where the product is needed. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields. This field is available in the API only.

ShipToLongitude.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address where the product is needed. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields. This field is available in the API only.

ShipToPostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToPostalCode.description: The postal code of the address where the product is needed.

ShipToState.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToState.description: The state of the address where the product is needed.

ShipToStreet.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToStreet.description: The street of the address where the product is needed.

ShipmentType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipmentType.description: The type of shipment. The picklist includes the following values, which can be customized: Rush Overnight Next Business Day Pick Up

SourceLocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SourceLocationId.description: Where the product is at the time of the request. This is a relationship field.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the shipment. The picklist includes the following values, which can be customized: Draft Submitted Received

WorkOrderId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkOrderId.description: The work order for which the product is needed. This is a relationship field.

WorkOrderLineItemId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkOrderLineItemId.description: The work order line item for which the product is needed. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: Field Service must be enabled. You can't use product request line item as a master in an master detail relationship (through a custom field) with a custom object with data.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ProductRequestLineItemChangeEvent (API version 48.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ProductRequestLineItemFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ProductRequestLineItemHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
